## 2026-11-03

### Impact

- **Stored data is protected by a hardware-backed key.** The SDK now checks that the key encrypting its local storage is backed by secure hardware (TEE or StrongBox). In release builds, a software-backed key (for example on a rooted device or custom ROM) is rejected and the SDK stops storing data on that device. Debuggable builds, including emulators, log a warning and keep working.

### Changes

- Added `TransactSession`, a session-based way to configure and present Transact, alongside the existing `Transact.present` API
- Released Transact sessions that ended without cleanup, and reported background launches through `onClose` instead of throwing; added `PausedTransactRef.tryResume()`
- Required a hardware-backed key for the SDK's encrypted storage in release builds
- Recorded which launch API opened Transact in SDK telemetry
- Updated the internal WebView library so a stalled page handler can no longer stop page events or lose a page close (Latest variant only)

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name              | Compatible | Build Version |
| ----------------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin            | 2.1+       | 2.2.21        |
| Gradle            | 8.11.1+    | 8.14.2        |
| AGP               | 8.9.1+     | 8.13.2        |
| Compile SDK       | 36+        | 36            |
| Min SDK           | 23         | 23            |
| Tested Target SDK | 36         | 36            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name              | Compatible | Build Version |
| ----------------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin            | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle            | 8.7+       | 8.14.2        |
| AGP               | 8.6+       | 8.6.1         |
| Compile SDK       | 35+        | 35            |
| Min SDK           | 23         | 23            |
| Tested Target SDK | 36         | 36            |

JetBrains tests Kotlin 1.9.x only through AGP 8.1, so the Kotlin Gradle plugin warns that AGP 8.6+ is above its tested range. The warning is expected. The build works, and CI verifies the legacy artifact against it.
